thesis: TGTX is a profitable, fast-growing commercial biotech in a clean uptrend, making all-time highs on roughly 2x average volume after a Q3 beat with raised guidance and an FDA-accepted Briumvi sBLA. Fundamentals support the move: revenue up about 61% YoY, positive free cash flow, and low dilution risk. High short interest adds squeeze fuel. The setup is only a conditional long. Price is extended, reward/risk is below 2 from the mid-zone, and the regime is risk-off, so the thesis only works on a pullback toward the 66.5-69.0 entry zone with modest size. Defensive-style healthcare strength (XLV) is a partial tailwind.
